intro.about: Quartz is MRI's anticheat. It blocks anything abnormal on the server (explosions, spawns, given weapons, forged events) and punishes carefully, adding up evidence. The code comes signed from our service and updates itself: only a loader sits in the city's folder.
intro.license: Up to {max} cities per Discord server: the main one and test cities, each with its own license. During the beta they are all complimentary, with no charge.

notConfigured: The Quartz service is not enabled on the platform yet.

noLicense.title: This server does not have Quartz yet
noLicense.description: Turn on the free beta test license to download Quartz and install it on the main city. It lasts 1 year and can be renewed here. After that you can add test cities.

status.revoked: License turned off. The city stops receiving the anticheat.
status.expired: License expired. The city runs the last stored version for up to 7 days.
status.notConnected: No city connected. Download the folder and install it: it connects by itself on the first start.
status.expiresSoon: Active, but expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
status.ok: Connected. The city is receiving the anticheat.
status.stale: (the Quartz service didn't respond just now, data from the last record)

actions.openPanelOffline: Connect the city first: the panel reads its data straight from the server.

install.title: Install in the city
install.step1: Download the folder and put {folder} in your resources.
install.step2: Add {line} to {file} and start the server.
install.done: Done: the city connects by itself and shows up here as connected. There is no key to copy. Each download works for one installation, and the folder copied to another city won't work.
install.inGame: In game, {command} opens the panel. It starts in Observe mode: it only records, nobody is punished.

move.description: Download the folder again and install it on the new machine. It connects and the old one drops off by itself: the license covers one city at a time.

disconnectConfirm.title: Disconnect the city?
disconnectConfirm.description: The connected city loses the anticheat. To connect again, download the folder and install it again.

addServer.title: Add a test city
addServer.description: To try Quartz on another server without disconnecting the main city. Each city has its own download and panel. {left, plural, =1 {# more city fits.} other {# more cities fit.}}

removeConfirm.title: Remove {name}?
removeConfirm.description: This city license is turned off and the city loses the anticheat on its next restart. The main city is not affected.
